test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

I told Pooja __that she could have use my car to get around__ while she is in my hometown.

options.text: that she could have use my car to get around with
that she can use my car to get around
that she could have use my car to get away
that she can use my car to get away with

solution:
The correct answer is** 'that she can use my car to get around.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **While **is a conjunction that is used to express what happens when something else important takes place. 
 
• **Both time and the main clause** should be in <stro
